messages:
Ellie Park (PM): Hey team — proposing a final release readiness sync before cut. Proposed cut date: Fri Apr 10 EOD PT. Can we meet Thu Apr 9 16:00 PT to run the checklist and get signoffs?

Ellie Park (PM): Draft agenda: 1) confirm cut + timing 2) infra canaries & metrics 3) DB migration plan 4) rollback + abort criteria 5) stakeholder signoffs (Legal/Security if needed). Pre-read: https://redwood.internal/docs/release/preread-0426 (please skim). Reply with availability and any additions.

Sam Patel (Eng Release): I can make Thu 16:00 PT. +1 to add "monitoring dashboards & alert thresholds" to agenda.

Kevin O'Rourke (SRE): I have on-call Thurs morning but can join 16:00 PT. We'll run a staged canary. Suggest explicit abort thresholds added to agenda. Also need deploy window + maintenance page copy. cc @deploy-bot

Priya Rao (QA): Can we shift 30m earlier to 15:30 PT? Need a short smoke run immediately before the sync. I can prepare regression checklist.

Jordan Lee (Backend): 15:30 PT works for me. Note: migration requires a brief write-lock (estimated 10m). We should order migration before final cut. I'll paste runbook here.

Maria Chen (Product): 15:30 is fine. I'll invite Legal and Security for signoff if anything with PII touches the release.

deploy-bot: Calendar invite created: Thu Apr 9 15:30 PT — "Release readiness sync" — Google Meet: https://meet.google.com/xxx-xxxx-xxx. Invite includes agenda + pre-read.

Ellie Park (PM): Thanks — updating agenda to 15:30 start per Priya. Jordan: please paste migration steps. Kevin: add canary metrics & abort criteria. Priya: attach regression checklist. I'll ping execs if we get green.

Jordan Lee (Backend): ```Migration runbook (condensed):
1) Ensure replica lag < 100ms
2) Run schema change script (online-safe)
3) Pause writes via feature flag (10m lock)
4) Validate data counts (quick queries)
5) Flip feature flag, monitor metrics
Estimated pause: 8m, reserve 10m.```

Kevin O'Rourke (SRE): ```Canary thresholds (suggested):
- Error rate > 0.5% -> abort
- P95 latency increase > 30% baseline or > 1s -> abort
- CPU/GPU throttling spike > 20% -> pause
Monitoring endpoints: /health, /v1/generate, /metrics
Abort action: rollback traffic to previous model variant + alert oncall.```

Priya Rao (QA): Regression checklist (short):
- Smoke test user sign-in
- Key API happy path (sample payloads)
- Embedding/Gen sanity checks
- DB sanity: counts + integrity queries
- Canary user cohort run
I'll attach the full checklist to the calendar invite.

Sam Patel (Eng Release): Quick smoke command for reference: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RELEASE_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health`

Maria Chen (Product): Confirmed attendees so far: Ellie, Sam, Kevin, Priya, Jordan, Maria, Aisha (Security), Legal (TBD). Please add anyone else who must approve.

Aisha Khan (Security): I'll join for the sync. Please highlight any data retention or export changes in the pre-read.

Ellie Park (PM): Great — locking Thu Apr 9 15:30 PT. If you can't make it, comment here and we'll record and collect signoff async. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Sam Patel (Eng Release): Recording on please if any execs ask for replay.

deploy-bot: Meeting note: recording enabled. Invite updated to include recording link post-meeting.

Ellie Park (PM): One more ask — if you add items to the pre-read, please @mention me so I can surface them to Legal/Security beforehand.
